thread:
lucy.z: Quick pitch  run a tiny "Rapid Heatmap" test: surface 3 micro-prompts on the signup modal and give tiered credits based on interaction depth. Goal = where users click first and which prompt types drive saves.

omar.r: Nice. What are the tiers?

lucy.z: Tier A: 20 credits on signup. Tier B: 20 + 80 unlock after run+save. Tier C: flat 100. Split 33/33/34.

sana.k: Landing note: the signup modal should record which micro-prompt is clicked and the sequence (click -> run -> save). We want a heatmap of click density and run-to-save ratios.

ops-bot: Ops checklist: add utm_campaign=rapid_heatmap, LD flag rapid_heatmap_v1, hubspot.lead_source=rapid_heatmap. Add events: modal_click, prompt_run, prompt_save, unlock_credit.

omar.r: Messaging quick variants: A) "Pick a starter prompt + 20 credits" B) "Start with 20 credits and unlock more after you ship" C) "100 credits to experiment". Keep copy ultra-short.

sana.k: Analytics: capture first_click_prompt, click_sequence, time_to_run, time_to_save, cohort. We'll visualize heatmap + funnel in Looker.

growth-bot: Add eval on micro-prompts please: https://internal/evals/rapid-heatmap-v1. Also suggest micro-survey on save toast: "Why did you save? [useful|fast|inspired]".

lucy.z: Owners: Omar (copy + social), Sana (analytics + dashboard), Ops-bot (flags + routing), Lucy (experiment owner). Timeline: mockups today, soft internal tomorrow, public Friday noon PT. Short daily pulse for first 48h.

omar.r: I'll drop a 3-frame GIF and two one-liners for the modal by EOD.

sana.k: I'll prep the heatmap dashboard template and baseline metrics.

lucy.z: Great. Next sync 9am for final sign-offs. Thanks! :rocket:
